placements.frozen: Exact seeded SDK with 32 frontend solver workers.
placements.disabled: Current SDK with the new caller-supplied pool absent.
placements.enabled: Current SDK with caller-supplied 16-core instruction pool and 64+32 curve placement.

calibration: Absolute paired median <=2% for same-build disabled vs frozen on each input.
qualification: Faster paired median and at least 9/12 repeats vs both controls on each fixture.
correctness: Fixed wires and matching public inputs, fresh external Gnark verification for each exported proof.
